record_note: Written after the fact (2026-10-13), not by the launcher. Warmup probe: D~29 at warmup 4000 (all else as the ladder). A calibration of the sampler, not a hyperparameter scan; selecting warmup by held-out likelihood would reward Monte Carlo noise. Supersedes beaker_warmup4000_try1_cancelled. Commits are the SHAs the container entrypoint logged and they equal the submitted spec's refs (asserted). Each task's subject_ratio is from the spec's own command and equals the ratio in that job's log (asserted); task order is never assumed. The extra fields wrapper_commit, foraging_models_commit, wandb_group, cluster, resources and tasks were added by hand.
